Experiment queue fails to run with --jobs parameter

Description

When trying to run experiments with the `--jobs` parameter to specify concurrency, the experiments fail to execute properly. The issue appears to be related to how workers are spawned for experiment execution.

To reproduce:

1. Create a simple DVC project with a stage:
```
dvc init
echo "echo foo" > script.sh
chmod +x script.sh
dvc stage add -n foo -d script.sh -o output.txt ./script.sh
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
```

2. Try to queue and run experiments with the jobs parameter:
```
dvc exp run --queue --jobs 3
dvc exp run --run-all
```

This fails to properly execute the experiments. The workers are not being spawned correctly when using the `--jobs` parameter.

The issue seems to be in how the celery queue workers are managed. When specifying multiple jobs, the system is unable to properly handle the concurrency request.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: dvc/repo/experiments/__init__.py, dvc/repo/experiments/queue/celery.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
